about_the_game:
Originally included only with the Nintendo Switch Limited Edition, this long awaited drama CD is now available digitally.
This work continues the story beyond El Shaddai Ascension of the Metatron and brings it all the way to the conclusion of the original novel, serving as the true finale of the saga.

Centering on Lucifel’s fall, the drama reveals unseen sides of the characters and their grand destinies, vividly brought to life by a stellar cast of voice actors.
A must listen for anyone who wishes to witness the world of El Shaddai to its very end.

Language: Japanese only

content_descriptors.notes: It includes references to characters' "flesh and blood" resulting from combat, and graphic descriptions of the process of bodily formation (blood, bone, muscle, etc.).
